code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential with elevated basophils and monocytes. There is also low total protein, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and alkaline phosphatase, suggesting systemic inflammation, possible tissue injury, and a prothrombotic state. Findings are consistent with acute severe illness (e.g., infection, hypoxia, or inflammatory process); urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
